subject: Project update
text:
I hope everyone had a quiet morning. I wanted to send a quick update before the afternoon rush. The cleanup project went better than I expected, mostly because the extra tables and chairs arrived right when we needed them. We also had a surprise helper from two houses down, which saved at least an hour. The side gate still needs paint, but the main path is clear, and the compost bins finally smell fine instead of awful. If you stopped by earlier, thank you. If you have a few minutes this weekend, bring gloves, and we can wrap up the last boxes. No need to reply to this note, just drop something in the garden shed if you have spare string or old newspapers. A few of you already know the details, but I wanted to write it down. The recycling area also looks less crowded, and the new sign is helping. I am genuinely pleased with how much progress we made.

Warmly, your neighbor
